home.aboutText: Welcome to our homepage, where you can experience that creativity knows no limits. Discover a world of unique offers and possibilities, from events, concerts, and shows to trade fair presentations to music productions and HIPOWDA® dance fitness events. As THE CREATIVE FACTOR, we not only meet existing standards - we set new standards by accepting challenges and turning even the most unconventional ideas into reality. With our one-stop shop approach, you experience seamless project planning and execution. But it's not just about technology and celebrities, it's about creating captivating choreographies, ensuring perfect artist interactions in order to create unforgettable experiences that resonate and leave a lasting impression. And rest assured, our commitment to safety is our top priority, with meticulous planning and on-site TÜV approval. Prepare to redefine your event expectations.
home.servicesText: Elevate with cutting-edge Sound, Lighting, and DJing. Create in our top-tier Studio. Boost brand through Music/Video Production and Marketing. Unleash talent via Artist & Model Agency and expert Management. Command stages with Show Dancer Training, Choreo, and Events expertise. Add flair with Mobile Bar and Catering. From La Grande Fiesta Latina to intense music manias, THE CREATIVE FACTOR redefines experiences.
home.eventsText: Seamless planning and execution. Dynamic trade fair management and booth construction. Awe-inspiring sound, lighting, and visuals. Expert logistics and coordination. Captivating entertainment. Meticulous technical planning and approvals. From corporate to grand celebrations, let THE CREATIVE FACTOR redefine your event experience.

abus.heading: About Us
abus.paragraph1: Welcome to our homepage, where you can experience that creativity knows no limits. Discover a world of unique offers and possibilities, from events, concerts and shows to trade fair presentations to music productions and HIPOWDA® dance fitness events. As THE CREATIVE FACTOR, we not only meet existing standards - we set new standards by accepting challenges and turning even the most unconventional ideas into reality. With our one-stop shopapproach, you experience seamless project planning and execution. But it's not just about technology and celebrities, it's about creating captivating choreographies, ensuring perfect artist interactions in order to create unforgettable experiences that resonate and leave a lasting impression. And rest assured, our commitment to safety is our top priority, with meticulous planning and on-site TÜV approval. Prepare to redefine your event expectations.
abus.paragraph2: Our homepage should give you a first impression of our and thus your possibilities for event design, trade fair appearance, hostess service, model agency, dance shows, DJing, professional dance training, music and video production, photo shooting, sound and lighting equipment, production & marketing, HIPOWDA® Fitness and our own music events. As THE CREATIVE FACTOR, we specialize in offering our customers new, unusual ideas in addition to proven concepts. True to our motto: "Nothing is impossible, doesn't exist!" we accept every feasible challenge. The realization of even the most unusual customer requests is a special motivation. Our "one-stop shop" approach offers our customers many advantages in terms of project planning and event implementation.
abus.paragraph3: A variety of show and light effects, the perfect music technology and celebrities alone do not guarantee the success of an event. Only the choreography of the entire event, the perfect interaction of the artists and the right event format and venue ensure positive effects and acceptance among the audience. Creating an aha experience and a lasting response from the audience is an elementary and indispensable communicative challenge. The technical planning reliability of the show and stage technology during installation and production must be guaranteed in accordance with VDE regulations. For this purpose, we ensure that the TÜV approvals take place on site (e.g. electrics, stages, truss systems for sound and light installations, laser and pyrotechnics TÜV), which releases the organizer from liability in this regard.

serv.title: Services
serv.des: Experience the next level of Events and Promotion with state of the art Sound, Lighting, and DJing. Elevate customer's brand experience through Music/Video Production and Marketing Excellence. Unleash your Talent or Product Placement with our Artist & Model Agency and Expert Marketing Management. Command the stages with Show Dance Training, unique Show Choreography, and Events Expertise. From La Grande Fiesta Latina to intense Music Manias, THE CREATIVE FACTOR redefines event excellence.
serv.des1:
Systems/Gear In Stock

We offer a comprehensive range of audio and visual solutions, including sound systems from 400 Watt rated power, versatile players, recorders for live-recording, microphones (both dynamic and condenser), lighting systems with PAR/LED options, effect devices, and more. Our offerings also encompass light desks, dimmers, various light effects, tripods, heavy-duty aluminum trusses, synthesizers, and DLP-Beamer setups. Additionally, we provide decoration services, mobile dance floors, stages, and expert technicians for seamless sound and lightsystem management.

DJing-Music

Our music selection spans a wide spectrum, from German hit songs of the 40s to today's chart-toppers. We offer genres such as Pop, Disco, House, Techno, Trance, Funk, Soul, Black, Hip Hop, Rock, Hard Rock, Heavy Metal, Salsa, Merengue, Bachata, Reggaeton, Latin Pop, Caribbean, Samba, Batucada, Axe, Tango Argentino, Flamenco, and Sevillana.
serv.des2:
Equipment

We operate a modern recording studio plus photo and video studio. Our facility includes an Apple Mac based digital recording studio with Digital Performer and Logic Pro software as well as a PC/Windows based digital music recording studio with software such as MAGIX Music Maker, MAGIX Samplitude, REASON and ReCycle. Our equipment includes analog/digital converters from MOTU and other renowned manufacturers, digital sound generators and effects from Waves, Native Instruments and many others. We use various high-quality microphones from the manufacturers AKG, Sennheiser, Beyerdynamic, Sure and RODE. Our services include music and vocal recordings, mastering, digital audio restoration and video production with Apple Mac and PC based digital video studios using Final Cut Pro and MAGIX Video Pro X. For mobile live recordings we rely on Apple MacBook Pro and MOTU Traveler. We also offer video recording options with various digital video cameras on hard drive recording as well as video and music editing. Upscaling with MOTU V4HD and digital photo studio services complement our range of services. And our experienced technicians for music, video and photo recording and editing ensure professional project implementation.
serv.des3:
Music / Video Production & Marketing

Our expertise extends to music and video production and covers all aspects from the organization and execution or supervision of recordings to the management of all production steps - from conception to the final product. Whether it's music on CD or HDD/SSD or a video clip on DVD/Blu-ray or HDD/SSD, we do everything customized. In addition, we are excellently positioned in the marketing and sales of the finished products via our in-house channels. We also offer valuable advice and support to artists with their own productions and marketing activities. Our services also include advice on image, styling and verbal communication for press and customer interactions, as well as advice on contractual matters with the assistance of specialist lawyers.
serv.des4:
Artist & Model Agency and Management

Supported by our experience, professionalism and joy in cooperation based on trust, we would like to set accents both as an agency and in management. The versatility and quality of our service reflects the demands placed on our work. We look forward to demonstrating to you the commitment with which your ideas can be implemented, because success is more fun together. As a link between organizers of live clubs, festivals and outdoor concerts, the artists and, where applicable, their record labels, we work closely with them in terms of promotion and scheduling. We stage events and artists. And that at any place, at any time and for any occasion. Individual, personal and unique – we tailor-make your dreams and ideas. Our portfolio is as diverse as your wishes: music from the catchy to the extraordinary, artistry in new dimensions, originally interpreted street art... Make your event unforgettable - we will help you with that.
serv.title5: Professional Show Dancer Training, Choreography & Show Dance
serv.des5:
Professional Show Dancer Training, Choreography & Show Dance

Enter the world of show dances with our unique show dance training supplemented by choreographies with a wow effect. We offer specialized training for original Latin American dances such as Salsa, Merengue, Tango Argentino, Traditional and more. Our dance school also includes lessons in Samba do Brazil. Experience our captivating dance shows with Latin American dances but also modern dance, hip hop, Afro and more. Our diverse team also includes hostesses with flair and artists/dancers for trade fairs and events. We design tailor-made choreographies on request and offer catwalk coaching for models as well as dance training for aspiring singers. In addition, we continually promote the further development of advanced dancers and professional dancers by showing them new perspectives of artistic expression.
serv.title6: Event & Trade Fair Management & Booth Construction
serv.des6:
Event & Trade Fair Management & Booth Construction

Transform your ideas into remarkable and expressive events through our extensive experience in event and trade fair management. We create tailor-made party and event concepts based on your preferences, develop captivating show programs and provide recommendations for artists. Our services include meticulous organization and coordination of parties, events, festivals and trade fair appearances. We have many years of experience in organizing our own events/festivals, with or without cooperation partners. Our know-how extends to the design of comprehensive trade fair appearance concepts with sound, light, shows and optional technology provision including trusses plus live recordings (music, video, photos). We also offer mobile bar and catering services as well as pavilions, lighting, seating, decorations, tableware and much more. Enjoy our mobile dance floor from SICO in oak parquet. Whether birthdays, anniversaries, company celebrations or other events, we specialize in making them unforgettable.
serv.des7:
Mobile Bar & Catering

Add that certain something to your event experience with our mobile bar and catering services. We offer bar counters for food and drinks as well as attractive bartenders upon request. Enjoy exotic cocktails and our glass service, which includes a selection of drinks such as sparkling wine, champagne, white wine, red wine and cocktails of all kinds in exclusive glasses. Our service also includes ice cube machines, ice cube crushers, beverage refrigerators, pavilions, decorations, lighting and fire bowls for the evening atmosphere. Stay comfortably warm on a likely cool evening thanks to our gas patio heaters with shelves. Our equipment includes seating, tables, dishes, cutlery and various appliances such as hot dog and bun warmers, ketchup, mustard and mayonnaise dispensers, grills, deep fryers, rice cookers, warming plates and more. You can also enjoy various delicacies and the culinary tempting South American and grilled specialties from our chefs.
serv.des8:
La Grande Fiesta Latina© FESTIVAL

Experience the vibrant energy at our superlative La Grande Fiesta Latina© Festivals. Immerse yourself in the rhythms of live music performed by Latin musicians and bands. Enjoy the stirring sounds of South American music, including Latin pop by renowned DJs. Be enchanted by Latino folk dance performances and experience dynamic Salsa, Merengue, Bachata and Samba do Brazil dance performances. Feel the passion of Kizomba, Tropical and Reggaeton dance performances. And treat yourself to the elegance of Tango Argentino dance performances. Join us for a celebration of Latin American culture and dance like never before.
serv.des9:
HIPOWDA® Mania

Experience the ultimate HIPOWDA® Fitness Dance Parties with our HIPOWDA® Mania Happenings. Be inspired by our professional dancers who will entice you to dance along with their cool moves right in front of the stage. Join us in this exhilarating dance experience where all participants dance exuberantly to electronic music. Discover the variety of dance styles that harmonize perfectly with the electronic music beats. Get ready for an energetic dance party that combines fun, fitness and fantastic electronic rhythms and beats.
serv.des10:
Mortal Metal Mania©

Prepare to unleash your inner headbanger at Mortal Metal Mania©, an electrifying metal music festival that will shake your senses to the core. Immerse yourself in the thunderous riffs, pounding drums and powerful vocals that define the metal genre. Whether you're a die-hard metal fan or simply interested in the genre, this breathtaking event promises an unforgettable experience. With live bands and/or DJs celebrating the raw energy and intensity of metal music, you'll be immersed in a sonic journey that will leave you wanting more.
serv.des11:
World of Hardbeatz© Festival

Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of the World of Hardbeatz© Festival. Get carried away by energetic beats and pulsating rhythms as we bring you live bands and/or DJs who will rock the stage with the hardest and most invigorating sounds in electronic music. Get ready for an unforgettable experience that will have you vibrating in ecstasy to the sounds of Hardbeatz© all night long.
serv.des12:
Rave Me Mania©

Get ready to enter the vibrant world of Rave Me© Mania. This electrifying techno music festival offers you a magnificent and unparalleled experience with selected live bands and/or DJs from the genre who will take you on an extraordinary sonic excursion with pulsating beats and spirited rhythms. Join the raving crowd and let the music inspire you as you dance the night away at this event.
serv.des13:
Epic Music Mania©

Experience the legendary drama and emotionality of Epic Music Mania©, an extraordinary music festival that promises an unforgettable journey into the world of epic sounds. With live bands and/or DJs, this event guarantees an unparalleled listening adventure. Prepare to be swept away by monumental sound design and bombastic music that will leave you in awe and giving you goosebumps.
serv.des14:
Pop Music Mania©

Come face-to-face with the world of Pop Music Mania©, a legendary music festival that celebrates the timeless appeal of pop music. Experience the magic of different eras, from the 1920s to the present. Groove to the iconic sounds of the 1930s, 1940s, 1950s and 1960s. Experience the hits of the 1970s, 1980s, 1990s, 2000s, 2010s and 2020s. And of course, enjoy the contemporary pop hits that shape the current music scene. Once announced, each Pop Music Mania© refers to one or more musical eras. With live artists, live bands and/or DJs, this festival promises an unforgettable musical journey that, depending on the program, sometimes spans generations.
serv.des15:
Trance Music Mania©

Get ready to be transported to another dimension at Trance Music Mania©, an ingenious music festival dedicated to the hypnotic beats of trance music. Let yourself be carried away by pulsating rhythms, fascinating melodies and enjoy the euphoric atmospheres. Whether you are a seasoned trance lover or a curious newbie, this festival offers an immersive experience like no other. With live bands and/or DJs creating the soundscape, prepare to dance detached and lose yourself on a fascinating journey through the trance universe.
serv.des16:
Weddings & Anniversaries

But before you can enjoy the day of your dreams, an exciting time awaits you. Plans are being made, preparations are underway for the wedding or anniversary. Perhaps a concept or motto is even drawn up under which the entire wedding or anniversary celebration should take place. From choosing the perfect location and designing the decorations to putting together the ideal music playlist and organizing every detail, we are your advisor to make your special day truly unforgettable. Let us handle the logistics, coordination and execution while you focus on creating beautiful memories that will last a lifetime.
